scenes.title: Why freelancers work for free
scenes.say: Why do freelancers keep working for free without noticing?

scenes.title: Where free work sneaks in
scenes.say: It sneaks in three ways. Endless revision rounds. A vague scope that keeps growing. And calls that nobody ever paid for.

scenes.title: Set a limit upfront
scenes.label: revision rounds, then it is paid
scenes.say: Write a limit into every quote. Three revision rounds, and after that, extra work is paid.

scenes.title: Put the limit in your next quote
scenes.say: Put the limit in your next quote, before the work starts.
